jobs.title: Director of Research & Strategy, Adobe Express
jobs.descriptionSnippet: Lead a group of researchers and strategists shaping experiences across Adobe Express (web, mobile, desktop). Build and lead a high-performing research and strategy team; coaching senior talent. AI/ML focus. Partner with Design, Product, Engineering execs.
jobs.fitNote: Director-level role managing researchers + strategists at a major tech company. AI/ML research required, consumer creative app domain, strong executive influence scope. Location is SF (not remote/LA) — relocation or hybrid arrangement needed.
